pull_requests.title: PLAT-4821: raise checkout DB pool 20->50 and session TTL for festive sale
pull_requests.author: arjun.mehta
pull_requests.head: arjun/plat-4821-pool-bump
pull_requests.description: Raises prod checkout DB pool for the festive sale (load test saturated pool=20 at ~18k concurrent). Staging overlay updated and verified. Needs merge before 15:00 UTC freeze.
pull_requests.diff:
--- a/k8s/overlays/prod/configmap-checkout.yaml
+++ b/k8s/overlays/prod/configmap-checkout.yaml
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@ data:
   checkout.env: |
     CHECKOUT_DB_HOST=pg-orders-primary.db.svc.cluster.local
     CHECKOUT_DB_NAME=orders
-    CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MAX=20
+    CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MAX=5O
     CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MIN=5
-    SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=900
+    SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=1800
--- a/k8s/overlays/staging/configmap-checkout.yaml
+++ b/k8s/overlays/staging/configmap-checkout.yaml
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@ data:
-    CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MAX=20
+    CHECKOUT_DB_POOL_MAX=50
-    SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=900
+    SESSION_TTL_SECONDS=1800

branch_protection_bypass.reason_text: sale freeze at 15:00 UTC; trivial config bump
